player_prompt.intro:
A nyi Player {player_id} to nu Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; a we kpɔnɔnɔ do a ɔmɔnɔnɔ kpa.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ɖeɖe round, {max_rounds} round(s) ɖeɖe.
- Nu gbɛtɛ lɛ: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X nyi integer ɖokpo ɖe a chip a we tɔn.)
- Ɔmɔnɔnɔ kpa ɖeɖe wu pot to showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Sɛ́ ɖɔ wɔn mɛ̀nyi akɔsi, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', ɖi '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: É sixu nyí [check] - a ɖò nǔ e è na cá é ɖé jí.
invalid_move.amount_min: Ðɛ́n / Nùnina ɔ̀ ɖó ná nyí ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: E ma ɖɔ hɛ́ '[bet]' - ɖi ma ɖɔ '[call]' / '[raise]' / '[fold]'.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: E ɖo na ylɔ mɛ ɖe a; e sixu [check] nɔ ye.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Zɛ [bet X] bo na hun; e sɔ́ ɖó ná sù ǎ.
invalid_move.insufficient: Akpá enɛ ɔ́, é kún kpé nukún dó wu ó.

board.possible_actions: Nǔ e a na wà lɛ é: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Gbọjẹ kàkà: mẹlẹpo {card}. Akọnta ṣẹja – eyin mẹlẹpo gba {split}.

outcome.draw: Akɔ́n ɖokpo ɔ ɖò lɛ̀gbɛ̌ tɔn lε gudo
